rule.text: 14 Get your Food Service Establishment Permit Done in real life NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) $280 21 days done in your season Yours: You got it on day 32. In general: Apply online with proof of workers' compensation and disability insurance, the sales tax Certificate of Authority and the Food Protection Certificate. The fee is $280 a year. You may open on the 22nd day after applying; call for a pre-operational inspection if you want to open sooner. Official page
